question: Should data-apis/stamen-map-tiles be related to data-apis/stadia-maps as same_offer_as, and should the Stadia Maps record gain the Stamen styles as further evidence?
why: maps.stamen.com has been served by Stadia Maps since 2023-07-31, and the Stamen styles spend the Stadia Maps free tile allowance. A discover unit has no record in scope, so a relate operation is refused by the lint and an append_evidence to data-apis/stadia-maps is outside this unit. The Stamen page's 200,000 tiles a month is a 2023 figure and was not re-checked against the current Stadia Maps credit terms.
